name: Grand Strategist Lirian Vael-Torin
role: Covert Military Advisor to Chancellor Zylox
notes: Entity record created 2026-08-09 to close a structural gap: this character existed ONLY as a charforge capsule, with no entity record, while being referenced by entity records (e.g. vessel crew_ids / commanding_officer_id). It therefore dangled from the entity graph and was silently omitted by every tool that indexes entity records. Core fields derive from the capsule, which is the authoritative existing canon; nothing was invented.

naming_exemption.reason: Name preserved verbatim from the committed charforge capsule (canon/L2/entities/lirian_vael_torin/capsule/identity.json).

capsule_binding_note: Explicit bridge between the two identifier namespaces. Relational fields across canon (crew_ids, commanding_officer_id, task_group_commander_id) refer to this entity by its CAPSULE id "lirian_vael_torin", while the record identity is "char_lirian_vael_torin". Before this field the two were connected only by stripping a prefix and hoping; tools/canon_reference_integrity.py now checks the bridge instead of guessing it.

alignment_nuance.independence: Remains an independent military thinker rather than a political loyalist.
alignment_nuance.why_recorded: The role field — Covert Military Advisor to Chancellor Zylox — reads as service. The source is explicit that alignment is not loyalty, which changes how the character behaves when strategy and politics diverge.
alignment_nuance.remit: Operates behind the scenes to shape Union strategy, military doctrine and political stability.

prose_ledger_triage.note: The "lirian vos" match was initially suspected of confusing this character with another, given a documented earlier mis-match of Lirian Vael-Torin against Vael Saros. It is not — "Lirian Vos" and "Vos" are recorded aliases of this record, and all five claims are his.
prose_ledger_triage.excluded: Four claims are simulation-integration metadata — the character being made an AI-driven agent, fully integrated into the simulation, a profile stored, a tweak applied — describing how the character was instantiated rather than facts about him. The alignment content within the last of these is retained.
